req.title: Root endpoint responds
req.statement: The system shall serve a welcome message at GET / with HTTP 200.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states GET / must return HTTP 200 with a specific JSON payload. To achieve high mutation kill rate: (1) assert exact status code 200 (catches 201/204/etc mutations), (2) assert exact JSON keys and values (catches string-constant mutations), (3) test that non-GET methods return 4xx (negative path, catches method-routing mutations), (4) assert each individual field value exactly (catches per-field constant mutations). BVA is applied by verifying the response body structure precisely rather than loosely.

tests.name: test_root_get_returns_200_with_exact_payload
expected: Response JSON contains message == 'Welcome to Task Manager API'
trace: R-TASK-018: GET / returns HTTP 200 with welcome payload
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_root_get_returns_200_with_exact_payload():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body["message"] == "Welcome to Task Manager API"
    assert body["docs"] == "/docs"
    assert body["version"] == "1.0.0"
    assert len(body) == 3

test_root_get_returns_200_with_exact_payload()
